alt: Bridal henna: full hand and wrist, a palm mandala, finger rings and a wrist band drawn in single-line henna
Concentric mandala: outer petal ring, middle ring, scalloped ring and dot ring closing on an inner flower
Peacock feather: a straight stem carrying one eye and barbs tipped with dots
Lotus: outer and mid petals around an inner lotus, seed dots and calyx leaves at the base
Paisley: a teardrop holding a second paisley, a heart dot at its center and a curled tail
Climbing vine: a main stem with alternating lobed leaf branches and small buds
